tables.title: List of events that trigger an interrupt
tables.text: Table 371, "List of events that trigger an interrupt", in section 40.8 (CSI-2 Host interrupts and errors) on page 2035. Columns: Interrupt flag, Register, Interrupt sources. 35 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section40.8.1: Error handling.; 2. Refer to Section40.8.2: Interrupt handling.

rows: (1)Synchronization error. The interrupt is enabled if SYNCERRIE is set in CSI_IER0.
(1)Watchdog error. The interrupt is enabled if WDERRIE is set in CSI_IER0.

(1)Corrected ECC error. The interrupt is enabled if CECCERRIE is set in CSI_IER0.
(1)ECC error. The interrupt is enabled if ECCERRIE is set in CSI_IER0.
(1)CRC error. The interrupt is enabled if CRCERRIE is set in CSI_IER0.

(2)inCSI_IER0.

(2)Line/byte event 2 reached. The interrupt is enabled if LB2IE is set in CSI_IER0.
